feeds.title: Ultra Running Magazine
feeds.description: Serving a loyal market of long-distance runners since 1981, UltraRunning magazine has long been established as the voice of the sport. Containing comprehensive and informative articles about all aspects of the sport of ultramarathoning, UltraRunning is a must-read for all who participate in the sport.

feeds.title: iRunFar
feeds.description: iRunFar is your home for ultramarathon training info. Our goal here at iRunFar.com is to provide you with the best possible information regarding trail running and ultrarunning anywhere. We provide a mix of timely news, educational information, editorial insight, race coverage, gear reviews, and other resources, all while we continue to refine our content to better serve your needs and interests.

feeds.title: RunUltra
feeds.description: This is the place to find out all there is to know about ultra running, ultra race listings and reviews from our runner community. The home of Ultra Runners. Find Ultra Marathon events, share tips & stories, read Ultra Running gear reviews & keep up with the latest Ultra Running news. Mission is to Inspire runners to do extraordinary events in amazing places.

feeds.title: HURT Hawaii Blog
feeds.description: Race and Training Information from the Hawaiian Ultra Running Team.

feeds.title: UltraSignup News
feeds.description: Get inspired and informed with the latest articles detailing UltraSignup's activities in the trail running culture and news. UltraSignup News small crew of passionate trail runners dedicated to creating a weekly news mix that adds authentic value to the trail community and invites new perspectives into the conversation.

feeds.title: Chris Ultra Blog
feeds.description: A blog by a guy named Chris who writes about running. Usually, trail running--often at the ultramarathon distance.

feeds.title: UltrAspire Blog
feeds.description: The journey of the Ultra-Athlete begins with desire, a compelling need to go beyond the last point of return... and then some...and more...and so on, and so on... In a world with the possibility of endless power and potential - You supply the Aspiration, we'll supply the products to keep the perspiration flowing.

feeds.title: Ultrarunning World
feeds.description: Ultrarunning, ultramarathon news and events from around the world. Ultrarunning World strives to publish unique material.

feeds.title: UltraRunning Destinations
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog. I hope you get some inspiration to run somewhere new from my log of Ultra Running Destinations. These are all places I've visited, so can personally recommend them for an ultra adventure.

feeds.title: Running Dutchie
feeds.description: Lucja Leonard loves ultra and multi-stage running and shares her experiences with others through coaching, training plans and Edinburgh running tours!

feeds.title: Running John
feeds.description: John Burton is a software product manager by morning, ultra runner by mid-afternoon. If he is not half-asleep on some conference call you can find him out on the trails tearing it up. Or slogging it out. Or just sitting on a comfortable rock in the sun catching his breath.

feeds.title: Rugged Running Blog
feeds.description: Rugged Running is a holistic running and fitness company. Blog posts contain articles contains Michelle Yates' personal accounts.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Ultrarunning
feeds.description: The Guardian is the world's leading liberal voice. Follow this blog for ultra running news.

feeds.title: The Runner's Trip
feeds.description: The Runner's Trip: Run Long, Travel Far, Discover More. A travel-oriented running site with stories and advice to help runners keep improving, stay motivated, reach new goals, and have more meaningful travel experiences by running in new destinations.

feeds.title: Davy Crockett's Running Frontier Blog
feeds.description: Davy Crockett, the ultrarunner, has written hundreds of articles about his adventures and races. Key topics covered are adventure run, running history, ultrarunning, training, race prep, short races, and 50K and marathons.

feeds.title: The Ultimate Direction Buzz
feeds.description: Ultimate Direction invented the entire category of hydration packs. We created the first waist pack for carrying bottles. Follow their blog to receive athlete commentary, product development and race updates.

feeds.title: RELENTLESS FORWARD COMMOTION
feeds.description: My name is Heather Hart, I am a mom. I am an athlete. I am a writer. I am an adventurer with a wandering spirit and wandering feet. I've gone from traditional road runner to aspiring triathlete, too obsessed obstacle course racer, to my current status as a trail loving ultramarathon runner.

feeds.title: Ellie Greenwood, Trail Running Tales
feeds.description: Ellie Greenwood is an ultra runner and online ultra runner coach. Subscribe to her blog for her various trail running and ultra running tales.

feeds.title: Man v Miles
feeds.description: London-based editor & writer covering tech, fitness & running. Mostly rattle on about run stuff, fun stuff, tips & clean eats.

feeds.title: One Foot in Front of the Other
feeds.description: Sam Robson love running, particularly over long distances. This blog is his rambling thoughts on ultra running. As he states - The literal and metaphorical ups and downs of an ultra-running journey.

feeds.title: John O'Regan's Blog.
feeds.description: John O'Regan is an Irish International Ultra Runner & Adventurer. He has represented Ireland in Ultra Trail / 100K / 24-hrs. This blog features his running adventures.

feeds.title: Rockhoppin' Trail
feeds.description: Linda Doke is a Rockhoppin' Trail runner who loves mountains, rivers, forests, valleys, peaks, contours, switchbacks, deserts, dunes.

feeds.title: Relentless Tenacity
feeds.description: A blog about ultra running, fitness, health, triathlon, Ironman to sprint, unprocessed food, low-carb high-fat nutrition, and with the odd rant.

feeds.title: Beth Cardelli
feeds.description: Beth Cardelli is an Australian female Ultra Trail Runner. Follow her blog to receive reports about her latest race.

feeds.title: Ultra Runner Girl
feeds.description: Stephanie Case is an Ultra runner, freelance writer, human-rights lawyer and founder of the nonprofit Free to Run. She writes about running, war zones, and everything in between.

feeds.title: An Ultra Runners Blog
feeds.description: A father, husband, son, runner, CEO. I run to keep it all real. Follow him along his journey to run ultras & other mind altering events.

feeds.title: William Sichel Blog
feeds.description: William Sichel is an international ultra runner and multiple world record holder from Orkney in Scotland.

feeds.title: John Kynaston's ultra running diary
feeds.description: John Kynaston have now ran 37 ultras over the past ten years including the whw 6 times. Visitors can read all about them, watch his race videos and lots more by using the tabs at the top of the blog.
